## Install

This is the launcher for KSP Retooled. It allows you to install retooled into
an existing KSP install. You will need a stock install of KSP 1.12.5.

There are different version of the launcher available depending on your
platform. Download the artifact that corresponds to your platform below.

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `KSPRetooled.Launcher-windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-arm64-Setup.pkg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-x64-Setup.pkg` |
| Linux | `KSPRetooled.Launcher-linux-x64.AppImage` |
